definition: William “Liam” Fedus is a machine learning researcher and entrepreneur.
details: He worked at Google Brain and OpenAI, contributing to research on large language models. At OpenAI, he later became vice president of post-training research. He was a member of the research group that developed ChatGPT. Fedus left OpenAI in 2025 and co-founded Periodic Labs with Ekin Doğuş Çubuk, a former Google Brain and Google DeepMind researcher. Periodic Labs said that it plans to combine machine learning models with automated laboratory experiments for scientific research.
